name: Ruins of Mathystra
summary: Stormscale naga hold Mathystra's broken halls on Darkshore's northern coast. Ghost Sabers haunt the ruins of this ancient night elven city, shattered in the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago.

sections.title: A City Cast into the Sea
sections.body: Mathystra once sheltered Highborne nobles on Darkshore's northern coast. When the Well of Eternity collapsed in the Great Sundering, great waves broke the city. They toppled its marble arches and swept much of its stonework into the sea. The surviving night elves left for smaller woodland villages farther south. Sunken courtyards and cracked foundations still face the battered coast.

sections.title: The Stormscale Vipers and Ghost Sabers
sections.body: Stormscale naga guard Mathystra's broken halls and drive away travelers who venture north past the Tower of Althalaxx. Ancient Highborne relics lie half-buried among flagstones, sand, and seafoam. Young night elves sometimes brave the naga to recover remnants of their heritage. Meanwhile, spectral Ghost Sabers stalk the broken streets.

faq.q: What used to be here before the ruins?
faq.answer: Mathystra was a thriving night elven city built at the height of the ancient Highborne empire. The Well of Eternity's collapse in the Great Sundering shattered the city and drowned much of it ten thousand years ago, cleaving Kalimdor apart.

faq.q: Who controls the Ruins of Mathystra right now?
faq.answer: Stormscale naga occupy the ruins, rising from the sea to claim the sunken pavilions and coastlines. They attack land-dwellers who enter their territory.
Ghost Sabers are ethereal, translucent felines haunting Mathystra's ruined stonework. Hunters seek them along the coast, and disturbing ancient figurines there can draw the spirits from the shadows.

faq.q: Why do night elves visit these ruins today?
faq.answer: Young night elves and scholars sometimes enter the ruins to recover Highborne relics left behind after the Sundering. Stormscale naga make the search perilous.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Mathystra as a warning of the ancient Highborne's hubris. Their reckless sorcery brought cataclysm upon their coastal settlements.
As a hunter, you may find Ghost Sabers prowling Mathystra's rubble. These translucent beasts are tied to the spirit world, and beastmasters seek them as striking companions.
